Your feedback and comments are highly appreciated. Reach us at plasticxpower@gmail.com.

help.title: How the Game Works
help.intro: Flip cards to match animal pairs and fill your discovery deck.

steps.title: Set up your adventure
steps.description: Choose an animal group and grid size. Larger grids mean more pairs to remember.

steps.title: Take turns flipping cards
steps.description: Reveal two cards per turn. If they match, they stay uncovered and join your deck.

steps.title: Keep an eye on stats
steps.description: Moves and time track your efficiency. In multiplayer, turns rotate automatically.

tips: Review matched animals in the discovery deck to learn their traits.
Use memory skills and collaborate with friends to clear the board faster.
